description: Batch 131 regression queries for overload control decision boundaries among rate limiting, queues, admission control, and load shedding.

queries.query: 면접에서 429 rate limit, 503 admission reject, circuit breaker fail-fast를 한 번에 비교해서 답하려면 어떻게 정리해?
queries.notes: Should retrieve the interview chooser instead of only circuit breaker basics.

queries.query: queue wait budget을 넘기기 시작하면 큐를 더 키울지 빠르게 503 load shedding할지 어떤 기준으로 결정해?
queries.notes: Should favor the system-design chooser over rate limiter algorithm details.

queries.query: rate limit은 통과하는데 DB pool pending acquire와 thread queue가 계속 늘면 admission control을 어디에 둬야 해?
queries.notes: Should route to overload admission diagnosis, not generic rate limiter design.

queries.query: load shedding을 켰다가 언제 다시 풀어야 하는지 queue age, retry rate, dependency p99로 판단하는 기준을 알고 싶어
queries.notes: Should find the router because the question asks recovery/admission runbook conditions.
